globalProperty.description: Comma-separated concept uuids of the stock adjustment reasons that represent routine consumption rather than an error correction. The Stock Adjustments report uses these to tell the two uses of an Adjustment apart: drawing down a non-drug commodity that has no dispensing workflow, versus correcting a miscount on a drug. Reasons not listed here count as corrections. Leave empty to classify everything as a correction, in which case no mismatch flags are raised.
